query: SELECT multi_turn_retrieval, use_agent, data_modality FROM cspaper WHERE (data_modality = 'Audio; Text' AND performance_on_hotpotqa = 'Clean ACC (AVF α=∞): Mistral-7B 51.0, Llama2-C 46.0, GPT-4o 47.6; Robust RACC/ASR (PIA Attack, AVF α=5): Mistral-7B 53.0/8.0, Llama2-C 34.0/11.4, GPT-4o 42.6/9.8') OR (evaluation_dataset != 'FAQ dataset' AND agent_framework != 'ToT');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
